senses.en: firm and not likely to change or fall

ex.en: The table is stable.
ex.zh: 这张桌子是稳的。

ex.en: A stable bus time helps more than a new paint colour.
ex.zh: 稳定的公交时间比新的油漆颜色更有帮助。

tip: stable 作名词是马厩。本条以形容词为主。

senses.en: the act of dividing, a part of an organization, or dividing numbers

ex.en: The younger division of the club meets on Monday.
ex.zh: 社团的低年级小组周一见面。

ex.en: Fair division of practice time matters when one team shares a single court.
ex.zh: 当两支队共用一块场地时，公平分配练习时间就很重要。

tip: 除法是 division。公司或机构的部门也用 division。

senses.en: how good something is

ex.en: The quality of the recording is poor.
ex.zh: 这段录音的质量很差。

ex.en: Air quality outside a school matters as much as the quality of the books inside.
ex.zh: 学校外面的空气质量和里面的书的质量一样重要。

tip: quality 表示质量时常不可数。

senses.en: costing nothing, or not busy, or not controlled

ex.en: Are you free after class today?
ex.zh: 你今天课后有空吗？

ex.en: Free entry to museums matters most to families who would not pay for a ticket.
ex.zh: 博物馆免费入场，对那些本来不会买票的家庭最为重要。

tip: free 表示免费或有空；freely 才是副词“自由地”。

senses.en: something that happens, or a race in a sports meeting

ex.en: The sports event starts at nine.
ex.zh: 体育项目九点开始。

ex.en: A public event in the square should leave a path so people can still reach the clinic.
ex.zh: 广场上的公共活动应该留出一条路，让人们仍能到达诊所。

col: in the event of｜如果发生
tip: event 是可数名词。

senses.en: a large farm bird, or its meat

ex.en: The picture shows a turkey, not a chicken.
ex.zh: 图上是火鸡，不是鸡。

ex.en: Turkey the country and turkey the bird are different words; only the country is capitalised.
ex.zh: 国家 Turkey 和火鸡 turkey 是不同的词；只有国名大写。

tip: 本条指鸟。国名是 Turkey，要大写，不在这一词条里展开。

senses.en: used to contrast with what was just said

ex.en: The plan is costly. However, it may save water.
ex.zh: 这个计划花费很大。然而，它也许能节水。

ex.en: The museum is free. However, families who live an hour away still pay for the bus.
ex.zh: 博物馆是免费的。然而，住在一小时车程外的家庭仍然要付公交费。

tip: however 是副词，前后常用句号或分号；but 是连词，连接两个分句。

senses.en: a building where important objects are kept and shown

ex.en: The class visits the museum on Thursday.
ex.zh: 班级周四去博物馆。

ex.en: A free museum still fails if the bus stops an hour before it opens.
ex.zh: 如果公交在开馆前一小时就停了，免费的博物馆仍然去不成。

tip: museum 重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a place that sells goods
to buy things in shops

ex.en: The shop on the corner sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 拐角的商店卖笔记本。

ex.en: A small shop near a school can feed a street, but only if the rent stays possible.
ex.zh: 学校附近的小店能养活一条街，但前提是租金仍然付得起。

tip: shop 作动词是买东西。英式常用 shop，美式常用 store。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday

ex.en: I review words at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我在周末复习单词。

ex.en: A clinic that closes every weekend leaves Friday-night injuries waiting until Monday.
ex.zh: 每个周末都关门的诊所，会让周五夜里的伤等到星期一。

tip: 英式常用 at the weekend；美式常用 on the weekend。

senses.en: following what is usual

ex.en: The conventional time is eight.
ex.zh: 常规时间是八点。

ex.en: A conventional answer is not always the fair one.
ex.zh: 常规答案不总是公平的那个。

tip: conventional 与方便的 convenient 不是同一个词。

senses.en: here now, or existing at this time
a gift, or the time now
to show or give formally

ex.en: All the students were present.
ex.zh: 所有学生都到了。

ex.en: The present bus timetable ignores the hour when the factory shift ends.
ex.zh: 目前的公交时刻表忽略了工厂换班结束的时间。

tip: present 作名词“礼物”或动词“呈现”时重音在第二音节。

senses.en: of Asia
a person from Asia

ex.en: The map shows Asian rivers in blue.
ex.zh: 地图上亚洲的河流用蓝色标出。

ex.en: An Asian writer on the list gives the class a voice one textbook chapter may miss.
ex.zh: 书单上的亚洲作家能给班级一个课本里某一章可能错过的声音。

tip: Asian 作形容词和名词都要大写。

senses.en: the form of something
to give something a form

ex.en: Draw the shape before you add colour.
ex.zh: 上色之前先画形状。

ex.en: The shape of the school day shapes how tired students are at four.
ex.zh: 上学日的安排会决定学生四点钟有多累。

col: out of shape｜变形；状态不好
tip: shape 作动词是塑造。in good shape 可指身体或事物状态好。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anybody can borrow the map.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以借这张地图。

ex.en: Anybody who misses the bus should know the office number before the gate closes.
ex.zh: 误了公交的任何人，应当在关门前知道办公室电话。

tip: anybody 与 anyone 同义，anyone 已在本库。疑问句和否定句里更常见。作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: a female parent

ex.en: My mother works at the hospital.
ex.zh: 我母亲在医院工作。

ex.en: A mother on a night shift needs the school to understand why her child sometimes arrives tired.
ex.zh: 上夜班的母亲需要学校理解她的孩子为什么有时疲惫地到校。

tip: mother 较正式；mum 或 mom 更口语。

senses.en: money paid to use a room or thing
to pay to use something, or to let someone use it

ex.en: The rent is due on the first day.
ex.zh: 租金在每月第一天到期。

ex.en: High rent near a school pushes workers farther from the bus they need.
ex.zh: 学校附近的高租金，把工人推得离他们需要的公交更远。

tip: rent 作动词是租用或出租。英式 let 也表示出租。

senses.en: needing rest

ex.en: I am too tired to revise tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚累得没法复习。

ex.en: Tired drivers on the school route are a reason to shorten shifts.
ex.zh: 校车路线上疲劳的司机，是缩短班次的理由。

tip: tired 形容人。tiring 形容事物令人疲劳。be tired of 是厌倦，不是身体累。表里的中文把轮胎混了进来，释义按疲倦来写。

senses.en: a rate out of each hundred

ex.en: A high percentage of students walk.
ex.zh: 很高比例的学生步行。

ex.en: A percentage without the total number can hide how many students are left out.
ex.zh: 没有总数的百分比，会藏起有多少学生被落下。

tip: percent 已在本库。percentage 前常用 a。

senses.en: having done something wrong, or feeling that you have

ex.en: The court did not find him guilty.
ex.zh: 法庭没有认定他有罪。

ex.en: Feeling guilty about a low score is not the same as a plan to improve.
ex.zh: 为低分内疚，不等于有了改进的计划。

tip: be guilty of 后接罪名或过错。innocent 已在本库。

senses.en: to take part in a game, or to perform music
a piece of writing for the theatre, or a game

ex.en: We play basketball after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后打篮球。

ex.en: Children who play outside learn to judge risk in a way that a screen cannot teach.
ex.zh: 在户外玩耍的孩子会学习判断风险，这是屏幕教不会的。

tip: 球类前不加 the：play football；乐器前加 the：play the violin。

senses.en: to send goods to another country
a product sent to another country

ex.en: The town exports tea.
ex.zh: 这座城镇出口茶叶。

ex.en: An export figure without a source is not a report.
ex.zh: 没有来源的出口数字不是报告。

tip: 名词“出口”重音常在前，动词重音在后。表里是动词读音。

senses.en: to use force, or to try hard to stop something
a struggle

ex.en: We should not fight in the corridor.
ex.zh: 我们不该在走廊里打架。

ex.en: Communities fight flooding with drains and trees, not only with photos after the water has gone.
ex.zh: 社区用排水和树木对抗洪水，而不只是在水退后拍照。

tip: fight 的过去式和过去分词是 fought。

senses.en: a small area of water, often for swimming

ex.en: The pool is closed on Monday.
ex.zh: 泳池周一关闭。

ex.en: A public pool that opens after school gives students a place to swim without a private club.
ex.zh: 放学后开放的公共泳池，让学生不用私人俱乐部也能游泳。

tip: pool 也可指共用的一笔资源：a pool of bikes。作动词是合伙共用。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: We had a wonderful time at the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会上我们玩得很开心。

ex.en: A wonderful score on one test is not a full picture of a difficult term.
ex.zh: 一次测验的好成绩，不是艰难一学期的全貌。

col: a wonderful time｜一段美好时光
tip: wonderful 已经表示程度很高，一般不必再加 very。

senses.en: to take air in and out

ex.en: It is hard to breathe in heavy smoke.
ex.zh: 浓烟中很难呼吸。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: of the colour of snow
the colour white

ex.en: Write your name on the white card.
ex.zh: 把名字写在白色卡片上。

ex.en: White roofs can reflect summer heat and make classrooms easier to cool.
ex.zh: 白色屋顶能反射夏日热量，让教室更容易降温。

tip: white 也可作名词，表示白色。

senses.en: big in size or amount

ex.en: We need a large table for the maps.
ex.zh: 我们需要一张大桌子放地图。

ex.en: A large school on the edge of town forces many children into long bus rides.
ex.zh: 城边的大学校会迫使许多孩子长时间乘公交。

tip: large 比 big 更正式，常修饰数量和面积。

senses.en: sixty minutes

ex.en: The talk lasted one hour.
ex.zh: 讲座持续了一个小时。

ex.en: An extra hour on the bus each day takes time away from sleep and homework.
ex.zh: 每天在公交上多一个小时，会占去睡眠和作业的时间。

col: an hour's walk｜步行一小时的路程
tip: hour 前的 an 不省：an hour。

senses.en: containing as much as possible, or complete

ex.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
ex.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一辆。

ex.en: A diary full of small observations can later explain how a neighbourhood changed year by year.
ex.zh: 记满细小观察的日记，日后可以解释一个社区如何逐年变化。

tip: be full of 表示充满；fill 是动词“装满”。

senses.en: drinks such as beer and wine, or the substance in them

ex.en: The school does not serve alcohol.
ex.zh: 学校不提供酒。

ex.en: Health class can name alcohol as a risk without telling anyone how to obtain it.
ex.zh: 健康课可以把酒说成一种风险，同时不告诉任何人如何得到它。

tip: alcohol 通常不可数。beer 和 wine 已在本库。本条不写饮酒方法。

senses.en: medical care, or the way someone is treated

ex.en: The treatment for the cough was simple.
ex.zh: 咳嗽的治疗很简单。

ex.en: Equal treatment in a classroom means the quiet student is heard as well as the loud one.
ex.zh: 课堂上的平等对待，意味着安静的学生和大声的学生一样被听到。

tip: treatment 可指医疗，也可指待人的方式。

senses.en: the continent east of the Atlantic

ex.en: She read a story set in Europe.
ex.zh: 她读了一个以欧洲为背景的故事。

ex.en: Visitors from Europe bring money to a town, but housing for local workers still has to come first.
ex.zh: 来自欧洲的游客给城镇带来钱，但本地工人的住房仍然必须优先。

tip: Europe 和 European 都要大写。

senses.en: to take place

ex.en: What happened after the bell?
ex.zh: 铃响之后发生了什么？

ex.en: Floods happen more often when drains were built for a smaller town.
ex.zh: 当排水系统按更小的城镇修建时，洪水会更常发生。

col: happen to sb｜发生在某人身上
tip: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。某事发生在某人身上用 happen to sb。

senses.en: the work of building

ex.en: Construction of the bridge will take a year.
ex.zh: 建桥要一年。

ex.en: Construction beside a school should keep a safe path open for children every morning.
ex.zh: 学校旁边的建设应该每天早晨为孩子留一条安全的路。

tip: construction 作“建设”时常不可数。

senses.en: connected with what is being discussed

ex.en: Please keep the comment relevant.
ex.zh: 请让评论和话题相关。

ex.en: A relevant example from the town teaches more than a distant one the class cannot picture.
ex.zh: 来自本镇的相关例子，比班级想象不出的远例子教得更多。

tip: relevant to something。反义是 irrelevant。

senses.en: unpleasant to look at

ex.en: The crack is ugly, and it is also unsafe.
ex.zh: 这条裂缝难看，而且也不安全。

ex.en: Calling a person ugly is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 说一个人难看，不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: ugly 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人，写作时要避免。

senses.en: truthful
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: Be honest about your mistakes.
ex.zh: 对自己的错误要诚实。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: a good result

ex.en: The book fair was a success.
ex.zh: 书展很成功。

ex.en: Success for a bus line is not a full photo; it is whether workers arrive on time.
ex.zh: 一条公交线的成功不是一张挤满的照片，而是工人是否准时到达。

tip: success 作“成功”时常不可数；一次成功的事可用 a success。

senses.en: a figure, or a quantity

ex.en: Write your seat number in the corner.
ex.zh: 把座位号写在角落里。

ex.en: The number of cars has grown faster than the number of safe places for children to cross.
ex.zh: 汽车数量的增长，快过儿童安全过街地点的增长。

tip: a number of 作主语时谓语常用复数；the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: to take pleasure in

ex.en: I enjoy reading by the window.
ex.zh: 我喜欢靠窗阅读。

ex.en: People enjoy a riverside path more when the water does not smell of waste.
ex.zh: 当水没有废物的气味时，人们更喜欢河边的小路。

tip: enjoy 后接 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: a person who is hurt by someone or something

ex.en: The report does not name the victim.
ex.zh: 报道没有写出受害者的名字。

ex.en: A victim of a flood needs a dry room before a speech about courage.
ex.zh: 洪水的受害者需要一间干的房间，这比一篇关于勇气的讲话更先。

col: fall victim to｜成为……的受害者
tip: victim 可数。不要把受害者写成有过错的一方。

senses.en: to harm
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: Floods can damage houses and roads.
ex.zh: 洪水会毁坏房屋和道路。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: a length of time, a full stop, or a lesson

ex.en: We have a free period on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 我们周三有一节空课。

ex.en: A dry period of only one month can empty a village tank if nobody measured the water.
ex.zh: 如果没人计量用水，仅仅一个月的干旱也能抽干村里的水箱。

tip: 美式英语里 period 也指句号。

senses.en: a flat piece of paper, or a covering for a bed

ex.en: Write both times on one sheet.
ex.zh: 把两个时间写在同一张纸上。

ex.en: A clean sheet on the clinic bed matters as much as the notice.
ex.zh: 诊所床上的干净床单和通知一样重要。

tip: a sheet of paper 是一张纸。

senses.en: to take someone to a police station by law
an act of arresting

ex.en: The novel says the officer did not arrest the child.
ex.zh: 小说写警官没有逮捕那个孩子。

ex.en: News of an arrest should give the charge and the date, not a guess.
ex.zh: 逮捕的新闻应当给出罪名和日期，而不是猜测。

tip: arrest 也可作名词。本条只作法律词汇，不写执法步骤。

senses.en: full of energy, or changing

ex.en: The club is dynamic, and it still writes the time.
ex.zh: 社团很有活力，并且仍然把时间写下来。

ex.en: A dynamic plan that changes every hour needs one person to update the notice.
ex.zh: 每小时都在变的计划，需要一个人去更新通知。

tip: dynamic 也可作名词，表示动力或相互作用。

senses.en: thankful

ex.en: I am grateful for your help.
ex.zh: 我感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: next to, or together with

ex.en: The path runs alongside the river.
ex.zh: 小路沿着河走。

ex.en: A clinic alongside the school saves the hour a bus would take.
ex.zh: 学校旁边的诊所省下乘公交要花的那一小时。

tip: alongside 也可作副词。

senses.en: to be in a flat position, or to be in a place
a statement that is not true
to say something that is not true

ex.en: Lie down if you feel dizzy.
ex.zh: 如果头晕就躺下。

ex.en: The village lies beyond the hill, so the clinic bus has to leave before dark.
ex.zh: 村子在山的那一边，所以去诊所的班车必须在天黑前出发。

tip: 躺的过去式是 lay，过去分词是 lain。说谎的过去式和过去分词是 lied。不要和及物动词 lay（放置）混淆。

senses.en: a tall narrow building or part of a building

ex.en: The clock tower is visible from the gate.
ex.zh: 从门口能看见钟楼。

ex.en: A tower without a light does not help the student who arrives after dark.
ex.zh: 没有灯的塔帮不了天黑后才到的学生。

tip: tower 可数。

senses.en: a person who creates art

ex.en: The artist talked about the poster design.
ex.zh: 艺术家谈了海报设计。

ex.en: An artist in residence can help a school see its own walls as more than empty space.
ex.zh: 驻校艺术家能帮助学校看到，墙壁不只是空白。

tip: artist 不限于画家，也包括其他艺术创作者。

senses.en: very unwise

ex.en: It is stupid to cycle at night without a light.
ex.zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是愚蠢的。

ex.en: Calling a question stupid stops the student who most needs to ask it.
ex.zh: 把一个问题说成愚蠢，会阻止最需要提问的学生。

tip: stupid 语气很重，容易伤人。课堂上更适合说 unclear 或 I do not understand。

senses.en: at any time

ex.en: Have you ever visited the city museum?
ex.zh: 你去过市博物馆吗？

ex.en: If a river has ever flooded the same street twice, planners should stop building basements there.
ex.zh: 如果一条河曾两次淹没同一条街，规划者就不该再在那里建地下室。

tip: ever 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句里的“曾经”多用 once。

senses.en: the feeling of being happy

ex.en: The concert brought happiness to the hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会给礼堂带来了愉快。

ex.en: Happiness at a win should still leave room to thank the team.
ex.zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置去谢谢队伍。

tip: happiness 通常不可数。happy 已在本库。

senses.en: to get better after an illness or a loss

ex.en: She recovered after three days at home.
ex.zh: 她在家三天后恢复了。

ex.en: A student who is recovering still needs the notes from class.
ex.zh: 正在恢复的学生仍然需要课堂笔记。

tip: recover 也可指找回失物。

senses.en: to become less, or to refuse politely
a decrease

ex.en: The number of late buses did not decline.
ex.zh: 晚班车的数量没有下降。

ex.en: She declined the prize and asked for books for the library instead.
ex.zh: 她谢绝了奖品，改为给图书馆要书。

tip: decline 比 refuse 更客气。也可作名词。

senses.en: a person travelling in a vehicle

ex.en: The passenger waited for the late bus.
ex.zh: 乘客在等晚班车。

ex.en: A passenger who cannot stand needs a seat, not only a slogan.
ex.zh: 不能站着的乘客需要一个座位，而不只是一句口号。

tip: passenger 可数。

senses.en: a piece of writing, a thing, or a/an/the

ex.en: I read an article about school buses.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于校车的文章。

ex.en: An article without a named source is hard to trust, however smooth the sentences are.
ex.zh: 没有署名来源的文章很难信任，无论句子多么流畅。

tip: article 也可指语法里的冠词 a、an、the。

senses.en: to be on one's feet, or to bear

ex.en: Please stand in line.
ex.zh: 请排队站好。

ex.en: A small shop cannot stand a year of road works that stop customers reaching the door.
ex.zh: 一家小店受不了一整年让顾客到不了门口的道路施工。

tip: stand 的过去式和过去分词是 stood。

senses.en: one part in every hundred

ex.en: About twenty percent of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 大约百分之二十的学生步行上学。

ex.en: A ten percent rise in rent can push a family farther from the school they chose.
ex.zh: 房租上涨百分之十，就能把一个家庭推得离他们选择的学校更远。

tip: percent 常与数字连用。英式也写作 per cent。

senses.en: a custom that has existed for a long time

ex.en: The dance is a school tradition.
ex.zh: 这个舞蹈是学校的传统。

ex.en: A tradition can change when the market no longer sells the old grain.
ex.zh: 当市场不再卖那种老谷物时，传统也可以变。

tip: 形容词 traditional 已在本库。

senses.en: in place of something else

ex.en: We walked instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们没有坐公交，而是走路。

ex.en: Planting trees instead of only widening roads can cool a street and slow the rain.
ex.zh: 种树而不是只拓宽道路，可以给街道降温，并减缓雨水。

tip: instead 可放句首或句末；instead of 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: of the Atlantic Ocean

ex.en: The map colours the Atlantic in blue.
ex.zh: 地图把大西洋涂成蓝色。

ex.en: A lesson about the Atlantic should name the coasts, not only the water.
ex.zh: 关于大西洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。

tip: Atlantic 作海洋名要大写。

senses.en: used for obligation or a strong guess

ex.en: You must wear glasses in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里你必须戴眼镜。

ex.en: A public promise must be followed by a date and a person responsible, or it is only a sentence.
ex.zh: 一项公开承诺必须跟上日期和负责人，否则就只是一句话。

tip: must not 表示禁止；不必是 don't have to 或 needn't。

senses.en: the space above the earth

ex.en: The sky cleared after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后天晴了。

ex.en: A dark sky at noon is a reason to send the team indoors, not to wait for rain on the pitch.
ex.zh: 正午的阴天是让队伍进室内的理由，而不是在场上等雨。

tip: sky 通常用 the sky。文学里可用 skies。

senses.en: a person who owns something

ex.en: The owner of the shop knows every student.
ex.zh: 店主认识每一个学生。

ex.en: The owner of a rented room and the student who lives there may want different repairs.
ex.zh: 出租房的主人和住在里面的学生，想修的东西可能不一样。

tip: owner 是人。所有权是 ownership。

senses.en: physical power, or a good quality

ex.en: Reading is her strength in English.
ex.zh: 阅读是她英语上的强项。

ex.en: The strength of a team is not the fastest runner if nobody passes the ball.
ex.zh: 如果没人传球，队伍的力量就不是跑得最快的那个人。

tip: strength 是 strong 的名词。优点常用复数 strengths。

senses.en: a drop of salty water from the eye

ex.en: A tear ran down her face, and then she asked for help.
ex.zh: 一滴眼泪从她脸上落下，然后她求了助。

ex.en: Do not tear the notice off the board before the class has read it.
ex.zh: 在班级读完之前，不要把通知从板上撕下来。

tip: 名词眼泪读 /tɪə/。动词“撕”读 /teə/。两个意思都常用。

senses.en: a country's military ships and the people who work on them

ex.en: The museum has a room about the navy.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一个关于海军的展室。

ex.en: A chapter on the navy should also say who built the ships.
ex.zh: 写海军的一章也应当说是谁造的船。

tip: navy 前常用 the。navy blue 是藏青色。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: short in time or words
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: Give a brief summary.
ex.zh: 做个简短总结。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: extra money or an extra good thing

ex.en: The shorter walk is a bonus, not the reason.
ex.zh: 路程变短是额外的好处，不是理由。

ex.en: A bonus for the canteen staff should not come from cutting the students' meal.
ex.zh: 给食堂职工的奖金，不应当来自削减学生的那一餐。

tip: bonus 可数。

senses.en: not fast
to become slower or make something slower

ex.en: The slow bus still gets us there before class.
ex.zh: 这趟慢车仍能在上课前把我们送到。

ex.en: A slow reader may understand a poem more deeply than a classmate who only finishes first.
ex.zh: 读得慢的人，可能比只求最先读完的同学更懂一首诗。

tip: slow 作动词是使变慢。表里这一行的音标是 sleep，本库不用。

senses.en: a long thin piece of wood or metal

ex.en: The pole by the gate holds the light.
ex.zh: 门口的杆子撑着灯。

ex.en: A loose pole at the crossing should be reported the same day.
ex.zh: 路口松动的杆子应当当天报告。

tip: pole 也可指地极，如 the North Pole。

senses.en: the only one of its kind

ex.en: Each student has a unique way of taking notes.
ex.zh: 每个学生记笔记的方式都不一样。

ex.en: A unique old tree in the schoolyard cannot be replaced by ten young ones in a plan.
ex.zh: 校园里一棵独一无二的老树，不能用规划里的十棵小树代替。

tip: unique 已经表示“唯一”，一般不再用 very 修饰。

senses.en: a box or bag that has been wrapped

ex.en: The package arrived at the office.
ex.zh: 包裹到了办公室。

ex.en: A package for a student should not be opened on a public desk.
ex.zh: 给学生的包裹不应当在公共桌子上拆开。

tip: package 也可指一套方案。pack 是本批的动词。

senses.en: at the end, after some time

ex.en: We eventually found the key in the lab coat.
ex.zh: 我们终于在实验服里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: A town that plants trees eventually feels the shade, but the first class of students may not.
ex.zh: 种树的城镇最终会享受到树荫，但第一届学生可能等不到。

tip: eventually 强调经过一段时间之后，不表示“可能”。

senses.en: a mistake, or responsibility for something bad

ex.en: The fault was in the timetable, not in the class.
ex.zh: 错在课表，不在这个班。

ex.en: Finding fault with a student is easier than fixing the broken step.
ex.zh: 挑学生的错，比修好破台阶容易。

tip: It is my fault 表示是我的错。fault 也可指地质断层。

senses.en: each one in a group, seen as a whole

ex.en: Every student has a chance to speak.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有发言的机会。

ex.en: Every extra degree of summer heat makes it harder to keep classrooms comfortable without more energy.
ex.zh: 夏天每升高一度，都让教室在不增加能耗的情况下更难保持舒适。

tip: every 后接单数名词；every day 是短语，everyday 是形容词“日常的”。

senses.en: a short group of words

ex.en: The phrase is on the board.
ex.zh: 这个短语写在黑板上。

ex.en: A phrase in an ad can hide the fee if nobody asks what it means.
ex.zh: 广告里的一个说法，如果没人追问，就能把费用藏起来。

tip: phrase 可数。

senses.en: to some degree, or completely

ex.en: The room is quite quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后房间相当安静。

ex.en: A cycle lane that is quite short still helps if it crosses the most dangerous junction.
ex.zh: 一段相当短的自行车道，如果穿过最危险的路口，仍然有帮助。

tip: quite a + 形容词 + 名词：quite a long walk。不说 a quite long walk。

senses.en: unhappy or worried
to make someone unhappy, or to knock something over

ex.en: He was upset about the broken window.
ex.zh: 他对打碎的窗户感到心烦。

ex.en: An upset parent needs a clear time, not only a closed office.
ex.zh: 心烦的家长需要一个明确的时间，而不只是一间关着的办公室。

tip: upset 作动词是使心烦或弄翻，过去式仍是 upset。形容词和动词重音常在后。

senses.en: with little noise

ex.en: The library is quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后图书馆很安静。

ex.en: A quiet street is not safe if the crossing has no light.
ex.zh: 如果路口没有灯，安静的街道也不安全。

tip: quiet 也可作动词“使安静”，名词“安静”。

senses.en: to put something with something else

ex.en: Add your name at the bottom.
ex.zh: 在底部加上你的名字。

ex.en: Cities that add lanes without adding buses often add cars as well.
ex.zh: 只加车道不加公交的城市，往往也增加了汽车。

tip: add A to B 表示把 A 加到 B 上。

senses.en: something that is known to be true

ex.en: In fact, the library opens at eight.
ex.zh: 事实上，图书馆八点开门。

ex.en: A fact about air pollution should be separated from an opinion about who is to blame.
ex.zh: 关于空气污染的事实，应该和谁该受责备的看法分开。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: fact 是可数名词。the fact that 后接从句。

senses.en: the direction between north and east

ex.en: The wind came from the north-east.
ex.zh: 风从东北来。

ex.en: Schools in the north-east may need longer heating, which raises the winter cost.
ex.zh: 东北的学校可能需要更长的供暖，这会提高冬天的费用。

tip: north-east 也可写作 northeast。

senses.en: pleasant or kind

ex.en: It was nice of you to wait for me.
ex.zh: 你等我，真是太好了。

ex.en: A nice park on a map is not enough if the path to it is dark and unsafe at night.
ex.zh: 地图上一个好看的公园不够，如果去那里的路夜里又黑又不安全。

tip: It is nice of sb to do 表扬某人的善意。

senses.en: official permission, or a good opinion

ex.en: The trip needs approval from the office.
ex.zh: 这次出行需要办公室批准。

ex.en: Approval that arrives after the bus has left helps nobody.
ex.zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的批准，谁也帮不了。

tip: approval 通常不可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: words that say someone did well
to say that someone did well

ex.en: Praise for the quiet student was public.
ex.zh: 对那位安静学生的赞扬是公开的。

ex.en: Praise that names only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
ex.zh: 只提分数的赞扬，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。

tip: praise 作动词是表扬。通常不可数。

senses.en: a feeling of happiness, or something that causes it

ex.en: It was a pleasure to meet the class.
ex.zh: 见到这个班是一件愉快的事。

ex.en: Pleasure in a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
ex.zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢那个传球的人。

tip: It is a pleasure 是客套。表里这一行的音标是 pleased，本库不用。

senses.en: a small bag sewn into clothes

ex.en: The key is in my pocket.
ex.zh: 钥匙在我口袋里。

ex.en: A pocket dictionary helps on the bus, and it does not replace the library.
ex.zh: 袖珍词典在公交上有用，它代替不了图书馆。

tip: pocket 作形容词可指袖珍的。

senses.en: soon

ex.en: The bus will leave shortly.
ex.zh: 公交马上就要开了。

ex.en: Shortly after the rain, the same two classrooms flood.
ex.zh: 雨后不久，同样的两间教室进水。

tip: shortly 是副词。short 是形容词。

senses.en: the coloured part of a plant

ex.en: The flower by the gate is open.
ex.zh: 门口的花开了。

ex.en: A flower on the desk does not replace watering the school garden.
ex.zh: 桌上的一朵花代替不了给学校园子浇水。

tip: flower 可数。

senses.en: complete, or including everything
the whole amount
to add up to

ex.en: The total cost is eighty yuan.
ex.zh: 总费用是八十元。

ex.en: A total ban on cars near schools works only if buses can carry the same children.
ex.zh: 学校附近全面禁车，只有在公交能运送同样的孩子时才行得通。

tip: total 作动词是“合计”。

senses.en: a member of an army

ex.en: The museum shows a soldier's letter from 1940.
ex.zh: 博物馆展示一封 1940 年的士兵来信。

ex.en: A history of soldiers should also say who grew the food they ate.
ex.zh: 士兵的历史也应当写是谁种了他们吃的粮食。

tip: soldier 可数。本条不写作战方法。

senses.en: to show, or to throw back light

ex.en: The mirror reflects the clock.
ex.zh: 镜子映出钟。

ex.en: The timetable should reflect the last bus, not an old hope.
ex.zh: 课表应当反映末班车，而不是一个旧的希望。

tip: reflect on 表示思考。

senses.en: forward movement or improvement

ex.en: She has made progress in listening.
ex.zh: 她的听力有进步。

ex.en: Real progress in a weak subject is often slower than a single high mark suggests.
ex.zh: 薄弱科目上的真正进步，往往比一次高分所显示的更慢。

tip: progress 作名词不可数，不说 a progress。动词重音常在后。

senses.en: approved by an authority
a person with a public position

ex.en: Wait for the official notice before you change the date.
ex.zh: 改日期之前请等官方通知。

ex.en: An official report that hides bad numbers does not help a town prepare for the next flood.
ex.zh: 隐瞒糟糕数字的官方报告，帮不了一个城镇为下一次洪水做准备。

tip: official 作名词是“官员”。

senses.en: of Africa
a person from Africa

ex.en: The map shows African rivers in blue.
ex.zh: 地图上非洲的河用蓝色标出。

ex.en: An African writer on the reading list gives the class a voice that a single textbook chapter may miss.
ex.zh: 阅读清单上的非洲作家，能给班级一个课本里一章可能错过的声音。

tip: African 作形容词和名词都要大写。名词指非洲人。

senses.en: before Christ, used with years

ex.en: The map marks the year 200 BC.
ex.zh: 地图标着公元前 200 年。

ex.en: A timeline that says 200 BC should also say how we know.
ex.zh: 写着公元前 200 年的时间线，也应当说明我们是怎么知道的。

tip: BC 表示公元前，放在年份后面。与 pc 不是同一个缩写。
